description:
Data transformation, ETL, and no-code automation tool optimized for non-technical users

EasyMorph is a data transformation, ETL, and no-code automation tool optimized for non-technical users. It is available only as a 64-bit application for Windows and works in a time-unlimited free edition unless a valid license key is applied.
Cumulative bugfixes. New parameter type: "Column(s) selector". Desktop: The "Use connector" button. Launcher: Tasks with parameterized Python scripts. Hub: The "File manager" section in boards. Full-screen mode and search for issues. Link buttons for related assets. New space feature: Connectors.
